chapter: Fats Waller, Zululand and the ideal band
title: The Sherman Hotel Panther Room with Gene Krupa and Jimmy Dorsey
summary: At the Sherman Hotel he is house band and MC in the Panther Room, with Katherine Dunham and Fats Waller.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: See, I talked about Art Tatum. Oh, another thing in Chicago there, that I might talk about. It was after 'The Three Deuces', was the man, Mr. Byfield liked me very much and he liked my MCing of the show and they needed an MC and a house band. Over at the Sherman Hotel in the Panther Room.
So I went over there and started. As a matter of fact when I opened there were three bands. I was in the Panther Room. And Gene Krupa was in one of the rooms and Jimmy Dorsey was in another room.

They were just doing one nighters. Gene had just finished working and I replaced Gene Krupa with my small band. And he played in an Upstairs Room and Jimmy Dorsey was in the Old Town Room and I was in the Panther Room. And MCing the show.

The Kathrine Dunham dancers were there and then Fats Waller came in with his band. But he just did the show. I was the MC and I was the show band. I played for the dancers and the and the comedians and what do you call them, the tricks, the guys that do the tricks?
The magician, the magicians. And then Fats Waller band would come on for the capper. For the stopper. And of course, I had known Fats for years anyway. He was just too much. He was just beautiful.
